Jordan: Kicking off Meridian Health onboarding. Quick sync: stakeholders, 60-day pilot, success metrics, and major risks (SSO, PHI mapping). Who's primary contact from Meridian?
Leah: Hi all 94 I'm Leah (Meridian PM). Internal owners: Ben (IT), Dr. Owens (Clinical lead), Priyanka (Data). Data residency = US-only.
Jordan: Thanks Leah. Proposed milestone plan: Week 10: staging connectivity + sample data; Week 34: mapping + smoke tests; Week 56: clinician pilot; Week 9: iterate and scale. Go/no-go at end of Week 4.
Samir: SE check 94 need a small NDJSON sample (50 rows) with masked PHI. Also please include expected avg note size. If >8KB we recommend chunking.
Yara: I'll own enablement & feedback. Plan: 45-min clinician demo, 1-hr office hours during pilot, and daily 1-question pulse. Also building a 3-question post-task survey.
Marco: Infra/security note 94 we'll require SAML SSO + SCIM for provisioning. Security intake ETA = 7 business days after docs. Also request SOC2 summary.
Jordan: Success metrics (draft): median inference latency <300ms, ingest error rate <0.7%, pilot clinician completion rate >=70%, 14-day retention >50%. Renewal risk triggers: <50% adoption or >2 P1s in 7 days.
Leah: OK on metrics. I'll send clinician roster and SOC2 link by EOD Thu. Also asking legal for the DPA extract about data residency.
Samir: Integration snippet (staging):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/ingest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer STG_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"patient_id":"m-1001","note":"follow-up note","ts":"2026-07-10T14:00:00Z"}'
```
Jordan: Action items recap: 1) Leah send sample dataset + roster + SOC2 (due 2026-07-02). 2) Samir to prepare integration doc + chunking guidance (due 2026-07-05). 3) Marco/security to start intake (ETA 7bd). 4) Yara prepare enablement artifacts + survey (draft 2026-07-06).
OnboardBot: Task created: "Meridian pilot dataset + security intake" assigned to Leah, Marco. Due 2026-07-02.
Leah: Quick Q 94 can Redwood host a 20-min pre-pilot clinician demo? Prefer week of 2026-07-12.
Yara: Yes we can. Tentative slot Tue 2026-07-13 11:00am ET. I'll send calendar invite after roster arrives.
Samir: One more engineering note 94 recommend enabling prefix caching for repeated notes to cut token compute. Will document in the integration guide.
Jordan: Great. If SSO blocks come up we'll consider scoped manual provisioning for initial pilot to keep momentum. Next check-in: Thu 2026-07-01 09:00 PT. Thanks all. :rocket:
